name: retinova
description: RETINOVA — Explainable AI for Diabetic Retinopathy Screening

scripts.stop:retinova: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Write-Host 'Stopping RETINOVA services...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; $p5 = (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.State -eq 'Listen' }).OwningProcess | Select-Object -Unique; if ($p5) { Stop-Process -Id $p5 -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host '  Express API (:5000) stopped.' -ForegroundColor Green }; $p8 = (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.State -eq 'Listen' }).OwningProcess | Select-Object -Unique; if ($p8) { Stop-Process -Id $p8 -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host '  MATLAB Bridge (:8000) stopped.' -ForegroundColor Green }; Write-Host 'RETINOVA services stopped.' -ForegroundColor Green"
scripts.status:retinova: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Write-Host ''; Write-Host '  RETINOVA Service Status' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '  ========================'; $pg = Test-NetConnection -ComputerName 127.0.0.1 -Port 5432 -WarningAction SilentlyContinue -InformationLevel Quiet; Write-Host \"  [DB]  PostgreSQL :5432  $( if($pg){'OK'} else {'DOWN'} )\" -ForegroundColor $( if($pg){'Green'} else {'Red'} ); try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/health' -TimeoutSec 3 -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host \"  [AI]  MATLAB Bridge :8000  $($r.matlab_engine)\" -ForegroundColor Green } catch { Write-Host '  [AI]  MATLAB Bridge :8000  DOWN' -ForegroundColor Red }; try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/health' -TimeoutSec 3 -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host \"  [API] Express :5000  $($r.status)\" -ForegroundColor Green } catch { Write-Host '  [API] Express :5000  DOWN' -ForegroundColor Red }; Write-Host ''"
